newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Casualty says Q3 charge $0.15/shr.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Casualty says Q3 charge $0.15/shr.

text.p: Ohio Casualty Corp said on Wednesday that direct losses from Hurricane Fran have totaled $9.0 million before income taxes.
The total after-tax impact on the third quarter will be approximately $5.3 million or $0.15 per share, the company said.

Losses from required participation in North Carolina windstorm pools are estimated at $1.5 million for a total combined loss of $10.5 million. Of this loss, approximately $8.2 million impacts the third quarter with the remaining development appearing in the fourth quarter.
